newsitem.title: POLAND: Farm Food sees 1997 net of PLN 8.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Farm Food sees 1997 net of PLN 8.9 mln.

text.p: Polish meat processing firm Farm Food SA, whose one-for-five rights issue starts next month, expects to net 7.9 million zlotys this year and 8.9 million next year, the firm said in its issue prospectus.
The prospectus said Farm Food, which netted 11.3 million zlotys last year, expected to earn 11.9 million in 1998.
The company expected sales of 200 million, 240 million and 260 million zlotys in 1996, 1997 and 1998 respectively.
By the end of October this year Farm Foom had netted 8.4 million zlotys on 169 million in sales.
The prospectus said group net over the three years would be at 9.8 million, 10.9 million and 19.1 million zlotys on sales of 350 million, 440 million and 520 million zlotys.
Farm Food's 600,000-share rights issue at 33 zlotys per share will beheld in phases from January 2 to January 23 and February 13 to February 27.
Funds from the issue are to go toward equity investments in the meat industry.
